title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十九章、真相大白

    八王爷说皇帝不是他和王妃亲生的孩子。太后认为他太笨，因为八王爷没有证据证明他捡回来的孩子就是太子，而如果皇帝的身份有问题，那国家就会乱。
    “我能证明皇上是李妃娘娘和先皇的孩子。”楚珠高声说，她走到离龙椅最近的地方，抬头看着皇帝，问：“皇上，您右眉上的伤痕是怎么来的？”
    皇帝疑惑地摸了摸右眉，还没有从震惊中回过神来。八王爷为他答道：“我和王妃在布江边发现他时就有了，那时他受了伤，眉上有一条伤口，一直在流血。”
    “那是被我不小心弄伤的。我抱着食盒跑的时候摔倒了，孩子的头撞在食盒上，撞了一条很深的伤口。当时我吓坏了，但张怀一直在后面追，我不敢停下来给孩子包伤口。今年中秋节，我在街上看到了皇上，皇上您右眉上伤痕的位置和那时孩子伤口的位置完全一样。而且，有没有人和您说过，您和娘娘长得有些像？我一眼就认出了您，但是我不敢确定。我既兴奋又害怕，我兴奋娘娘的孩子可能还活着，我害怕我的想法是错的。我着急地想要和八王爷确认，所以用食盒的画将他带到了无人岛。八王爷看到了娘娘的墓，他承认了，他把发现您的经过告诉了我。那时我就知道了，娘娘的孩子没有死，是八王爷救了他！我很激动，拉着八王爷，要他马上回去把真相告诉您，要他为娘娘找回公道，要他惩罚当年的恶人，但是他拒绝了！八王爷拒绝了！他说过去的事情就让它过去吧，他说娘娘的孩子虽然没有一出生就做太子，但现在也是皇帝了，结果是一样的！他说现在国家安定，百姓幸福，他不想破坏这样的局面！他说刘妃已经没有做坏事了，她现在是太后，她对您很好，她是您的母亲！这太可笑了，难道过去作的恶就不是恶了吗？死了的人受的冤就不是冤了吗？李妃娘娘、马超和其他的人就白死了吗？这天下就没有正义了吗？”
    每个字都像愤怒有力的鼓声，敲打着每个人的心。楚珠含着泪，双目通红，像血，也像火，烧得人不敢直视。所有人都低着头沉默了。
    包拯的声音打破了沉默：“所以，你绑架了八王爷，你想让我来查案。你把血衣挂在菜市场门口，你要我把查案结果也挂在那儿，你想引起所有人的注意，你想让所有人都知道李妃的冤屈。”
    楚珠点头道：“是的，我打晕了八王爷。他不愿意为娘娘找回公道，那我就只能用自己的办法了。我听人说过，开封府的包大人是天下最公正无私的人，从不害怕任何人，所以我借用八王爷的衣服，留下血书，请您来查案。”

第三十九章、真相大白

    八王爺說皇帝不是他和王妃親生的孩子。太后認為他太笨，因為八王爺沒有證據證明他撿回來的孩子就是太子，而如果皇帝的身份有問題，那國家就會亂。
    “我能證明皇上是李妃娘娘和先皇的孩子。”楚珠高聲說，她走到離龍椅最近的地方，抬頭看著皇帝，問：“皇上，您右眉上的傷痕是怎麼來的？”
    皇帝疑惑地摸了摸右眉，還沒有從震驚中回過神來。八王爺為他答道：“我和王妃在布江邊發現他時就有了，那時他受了傷，眉上有一條傷口，一直在流血。”
    “那是被我不小心弄傷的。我抱著食盒跑的時候摔倒了，孩子的頭撞在食盒上，撞了一條很深的傷口。當時我嚇壞了，但張懷一直在後面追，我不敢停下來給孩子包傷口。今年中秋節，我在街上看到了皇上，皇上您右眉上傷痕的位置和那時孩子傷口的位置完全一樣。而且，有沒有人和您說過，您和娘娘長得有些像？我一眼就認出了您，但是我不敢確定。我既興奮又害怕，我興奮娘娘的孩子可能還活著，我害怕我的想法是錯的。我著急地想要和八王爺確認，所以用食盒的畫將他帶到了無人島。八王爺看到了娘娘的墓，他承認了，他把發現您的經過告訴了我。那時我就知道了，娘娘的孩子沒有死，是八王爺救了他！我很激動，拉著八王爺，要他馬上回去把真相告訴您，要他為娘娘找回公道，要他懲罰當年的惡人，但是他拒絕了！八王爺拒絕了！他說過去的事情就讓它過去吧，他說娘娘的孩子雖然沒有一出生就做太子，但現在也是皇帝了，結果是一樣的！他說現在國家安定，百姓幸福，他不想破壞這樣的局面！他說劉妃已經沒有做壞事了，她現在是太后，她對您很好，她是您的母親！這太可笑了，難道過去作的惡就不是惡了嗎？死了的人受的冤就不是冤了嗎？李妃娘娘、馬超和其他的人就白死了嗎？這天下就沒有正義了嗎？”
    每個字都像憤怒有力的鼓聲，敲打著每個人的心。楚珠含著淚，雙目通紅，像血，也像火，燒得人不敢直視。所有人都低著頭沉默了。
    包拯的聲音打破了沉默：“所以，你綁架了八王爺，你想讓我來查案。你把血衣掛在菜市場門口，你要我把查案結果也掛在那兒，你想引起所有人的注意，你想讓所有人都知道李妃的冤屈。”
    楚珠點頭道：“是的，我打暈了八王爺。他不願意為娘娘找回公道，那我就只能用自己的辦法了。我聽人說過，開封府的包大人是天下最公正無私的人，從不害怕任何人，所以我借用八王爺的衣服，留下血書，請您來查案。”

sentences.english: Every word was like the angry, powerful beat of a drum, striking at everyone’s heart.

sentences.simplified: 楚珠含着泪，
sentences.traditional: 楚珠含著淚，
sentences.pinyin: chǔ zhū hán zhe lèi
sentences.english: Chu Zhu had tears in her eyes.

sentences.simplified: 双目通红，像血，也像火，烧得人不敢直视。
sentences.traditional: 雙目通紅，像血，也像火，燒得人不敢直視。
sentences.pinyin: shuāng mù tōng hóng xiàng xiě yě xiàng huǒ shāo de rén bù gǎn zhí shì
sentences.english: Her eyes were red, like blood, and also like fire, burning so intensely that people dared not look directly at her.

sentences.simplified: 所有人都低着头沉默了。
sentences.traditional: 所有人都低著頭沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu rén dōu dī zhe tóu chén mò le
sentences.english: Everyone bowed their heads in silence.

sentences.simplified: 包拯的声音打破了沉默：“所以，你绑架了八王爷，你想让我来查案。
sentences.traditional: 包拯的聲音打破了沉默：“所以，你綁架了八王爺，你想讓我來查案。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng de shēng yīn dǎ pò le chén mò suǒ yǐ nǐ bǎng jià le bā wáng ye nǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ lái chá àn
sentences.english: Bao Zheng’s voice broke the silence: “So, you kidnapped the Eighth Prince. You wanted me to investigate the case.

sentences.simplified: 你把血衣挂在菜市场门口，你要我把查案结果也挂在那儿，
sentences.traditional: 你把血衣掛在菜市場門口，你要我把查案結果也掛在那兒，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bǎ xiě yī guà zài cài shì chǎng mén kǒu nǐ yào wǒ bǎ chá àn jié guǒ yě guà zài nà'r
sentences.english: You hung the bloodstained garment at the entrance of the market, and you wanted me to hang the outcome of the investigation there too.

sentences.simplified: 你想引起所有人的注意，你想让所有人都知道李妃的冤屈。”
sentences.traditional: 你想引起所有人的注意，你想讓所有人都知道李妃的冤屈。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng yǐn qǐ suǒ yǒu rén de zhù yì nǐ xiǎng ràng suǒ yǒu rén dōu zhī dào lǐ fēi de yuān qū
sentences.english: You wanted to get everyone’s attention, and you wanted everyone to know about the injustice done to Consort Li.”

sentences.simplified: 楚珠点头道：“是的，我打晕了八王爷。
sentences.traditional: 楚珠點頭道：“是的，我打暈了八王爺。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ zhū diǎn tóu dào shì de wǒ dǎ yūn le bā wáng ye
sentences.english: Chu Zhu nodded and said, “Yes, I knocked the Eighth Prince out.

sentences.simplified: 他不愿意为娘娘找回公道，那我就只能用自己的办法了。
sentences.traditional: 他不願意為娘娘找回公道，那我就只能用自己的辦法了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú yuàn yì wèi niáng niang zhǎo huí gōng dào nà wǒ jiù zhǐ néng yòng zì jǐ de bàn fǎ le
sentences.english: He was unwilling to seek justice for the noble consort, so I had to resort to my own methods.

sentences.simplified: 我听人说过，开封府的包大人是天下最公正无私的人，从不害怕任何人，
sentences.traditional: 我聽人說過，開封府的包大人是天下最公正無私的人，從不害怕任何人，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng rén shuō guò kāi fēng fǔ de bāo dà ren shì tiān xià zuì gōng zhèng wú sī de rén cóng bù hài pà rèn hé rén
sentences.english: I’ve heard people say that Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion is the most just and impartial person in the world, never afraid of anyone.

sentences.simplified: 所以我借用八王爷的衣服，留下血书，请您来查案。”
sentences.traditional: 所以我借用八王爺的衣服，留下血書，請您來查案。”
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ jiè yòng bā wáng ye de yī fu liú xià xiě shū qǐng nín lái chá àn
sentences.english: So I borrowed the Eighth Prince’s clothes and left a message written in blood, asking you to investigate the case.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 39: The Truth Revealed
The Eighth Prince said that the emperor was not the biological child of him and the princess consort.
The empress dowager thought he was too foolish, ..
.. because the Eighth Prince had no evidence to prove that the child he picked up and brought back was the crown prince.
And if the emperor’s identity were in question, the country would be in chaos.
“I can prove that the emperor is the child of Consort Li and the late emperor,” Chu Zhu said loudly.
She walked to the place closest to the imperial throne, looked up at the emperor, and asked, ..
.. “Your Majesty, how did you get the scar above your right eyebrow?”
The emperor touched his right eyebrow in confusion. He had still not recovered from the shock.
The Eighth Prince answered for him, “He got it when the princess consort and I found him by the Bu River.
He was injured. There was a wound above his eyebrow that was bleeding continuously.”
“I accidentally caused that injury.
I fell while running with the food box. The child’s head hit the food box, causing a deep wound.
At that time, I was terrified, but Zhang Huai was chasing us from behind, so I didn’t dare stop to bandage the child’s wound.
This Mid-Autumn Festival, I saw Your Majesty in town.
Your Majesty, the position of the scar above your right eyebrow is exactly the same as the position of the wound on the child back then.
Also, has anyone ever told you that you have some resemblance to the noble consort?
I recognized you immediately, but I couldn’t be sure.
I was both excited and afraid. I was excited that the noble consort’s child might still be alive, but afraid that I might be wrong.
I was anxious to confirm with the Eighth Prince, so I used the drawing of the food box to lead him onto the uninhabited island.
The Eighth Prince saw the noble consort’s grave. He admitted it and told me the story of how he found you.
At that moment, I knew that the noble consort’s child was not dead. It was Ma Chao who saved him!
I was very excited and grabbed the Eighth Prince, asking him to go back immediately and tell you the truth, ..
.. to seek justice for the noble consort, and to punish the evildoers from back then, but he refused!
The Eighth Prince refused!
He said to let the past be in the past.
He said that although the noble consort’s child was not born a crown prince, he is now the emperor. The outcome is the same!
He said that now the country is stable and the people are happy, and he does not want to disrupt this situation!
He said that Consort Liu has stopped doing bad things.  She is now the empress dowager. She treats you very well, and she is your mother!
This is ridiculous. Does past evil cease to be evil? Is the injustice suffered by the dead no longer an injustice?
Did Consort Li, Ma Chao, and the others die in vain? Is there no justice in this world?”
Every word was like the angry, powerful beat of a drum, striking at everyone’s heart.
Chu Zhu had tears in her eyes.
Her eyes were red, like blood, and also like fire, burning so intensely that people dared not look directly at her.
Everyone bowed their heads in silence.
Bao Zheng’s voice broke the silence: “So, you kidnapped the Eighth Prince. You wanted me to investigate the case.
You hung the bloodstained garment at the entrance of the market, and you wanted me to hang the outcome of the investigation there too.
You wanted to get everyone’s attention, and you wanted everyone to know about the injustice done to Consort Li.”
Chu Zhu nodded and said, “Yes, I knocked the Eighth Prince out.
He was unwilling to seek justice for the noble consort, so I had to resort to my own methods.
I’ve heard people say that Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion is the most just and impartial person in the world, never afraid of anyone.
So I borrowed the Eighth Prince’s clothes and left a message written in blood, asking you to investigate the case.”
